CustomField.description: The prefill flow for submissions started from this Campaign, so one Form Template can serve many Campaigns that each prefill differently. It runs instead of the template's own Prefill Flow; leave blank to keep the template's. Use it for prefill that needs a query, such as a prior submission or filtered related records, which source field mappings cannot express. Flow API names differ by org, so an admin adds this org's flows as picklist values.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Pick the autolaunched flow to prefill new submissions started from this Campaign, and it runs instead of the flow set on the Form Template. Leave it blank to keep using the template's own flow. Reach for this only when a field mapping cannot get there, such as copying from an earlier submission or from a filtered set of related records. An administrator maintains the available flows on this picklist.
CustomField.label: Form Prefill Flow
